name: delivery-collector
description: Headless run recorder: tracks a run's stages, gate decisions and QA evidence on disk and exports its Markdown report. No page, no port, nothing rendered.

project_directory.title: Project directory
project_directory.description: The git worktree this collector records for. A relative report path is resolved against it. Leave unset to use the server's working directory.

state_directory.title: Run state directory
state_directory.description: Where run files and exported reports are stored. Leave unset to use a per-project folder under your Claude configuration directory.

tools.name: open_dashboard
tools.description: Report where this surface records to. Headless: there is no URL.

tools.name: start_run
tools.description: Start recording a run and declare its stages.

tools.name: record_prompt
tools.description: Append a prompt to a run's prompt history.

tools.name: set_run_context
tools.description: Persist the change kind, the approval decision, and the handoff marker.

tools.name: update_stage
tools.description: Update a stage's status, output, links, QA scenarios and monitoring findings.

tools.name: finish_run
tools.description: Close a run with a final status and summary.

tools.name: export_report
tools.description: Write a run's Markdown report to disk.
